title: Etale source inverse image preserves universal coefficient arrows
statement: Let Z be a scheme, q:R→S a homomorphism of commutative rings in Type(u+1), C a derived R-module sheaf and Cprime a derived S-module sheaf on Z_et. Suppose δ:C→Res_q(Cprime) is initial as a structured arrow for derived scalar restriction [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows]. For every V in Z_et, the specified etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Z q δ V [def-weil-pbc-etale-isomorphism-normalization-arrow] is initial for derived scalar restriction on V_et. Neither boundedness nor flatness of S over R is assumed. This is a preservation statement, with no comparison site, adic tower, realization or descent equation.

source.place: Tags 06YS (K-flat resolutions), 0G7E (pullback preserves K-flat complexes with flat terms), and 0D6D (composition of derived pullbacks). Also proetale.tex Tag 09B1 for exact conservative comparison, or the small etale site Tag 03ED for etale source restriction, respectively.

proof.text: Identify fixed-ring sheaves with modules over their constant ring sheaves. Initiality identifies δ with the scalar-adjunction unit followed by an isomorphism from derived scalar extension of C to Cprime. Resolve C by a K-flat complex with flat terms. Inverse image to an etale source preserves flatness and K-flatness. Both orders of inverse image and extension are the same sheafified balanced tensor complex, giving the invertible inverse scalar mate.

The tensor-unit equation x↦1 tensor x identifies transport of δ with the particular localized normalizationPullbackIso in etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow, rather than an arbitrary coefficient interchange. The transported arrow is the new scalar-adjunction unit followed by the invertible tensor mate and the pulled target isomorphism. The unit is initial, and transport along the target isomorphism proves the claim. No Tor bound or nonempty-source hypothesis is used.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSourceNormalization_universal (Z : Scheme.{u})
    {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (q : R →+* S)
    {C : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))}
    {C' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S))}
    (δ : C ⟶ (normalizationRestrict Z.smallEtaleTopology q).obj C')
    (h : Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal
      (StructuredArrow.mk δ : StructuredArrow _
        (normalizationRestrict Z.smallEtaleTopology q))))
    (V : Z.Etale) :
    Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk
      (etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Z q δ V)))
